sensor.symbol_lineage: GCEZ26 historical; live front/active GC contract must be explicitly selected and logged
sensor.aggressor_semantics: BUY only is_buy=1,is_sell=0; SELL only is_sell=1,is_buy=0; dual flags excluded
sensor.causal_quantiles: prior 240 completed M1 bars, shifted one bar

execution.order_start: first executable XAU quote in the next M1 after completed GC signal information
execution.entry: BUY LIMIT at order_start Ask - 1.00 * ATR14(XAU M1)
execution.fill_semantics: Ask touches/crosses limit; research fill price is limit price

clock.live_rule: derive/log broker-server-to-UTC mapping and disable new orders if mapping differs from configured/verified mapping

demo_logging_required: GC signal UTC timestamp and frozen feature values
XAU order-start timestamp, bid, ask, ATR, limit
spread at order start and fill
server UTC offset and symbol trading constraints
all rejected/failed trade operations with error code
forbidden_demo_changes: new spread threshold selected from demo outcomes
risk increase above 0.25% before separate approval
promotion: Demo is forward/OOS implementation validation, not live/funded authorization
